notes.title: Chorizo Update - Patch note 1.0.8
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Deathliverers![/p][p][/p][h3]We're continuing to update the Pizza Deathlivery demo, and we're taking on all the feedback you give us![/h3][p][/p][h2]In summary:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/26a44dc48017083bdd89ad2b3a21ed1e1003d6e7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]In detail:[/h2][list][*][p]Fix: "ghost object" in hand preventing to take other objects,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix grabbable objects position on level reload start,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix dead player not register as spectator and stuck on their ragdoll body,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix (Hopefully) random invisible players,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: run animation when being freeze,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Balloon Head stuck in laughing animation even if player was delivered,[/p][/*][*][p]Improve performance,[/p][/*][*][p]Option menu modification - Brightness is inside "Graphics" option now,[/p][/*][*][p]Add sounds for door, chorizo & barricades[/p][/*][*][p]Add buildings (cinema, gas station, coffe shop)[/p][/*][*][p]Add a first floor in the emergency with an escape[/p][/*][*][p]Rework onboarding (tutorial)[/p][/*][*][p]Add interactable door and lockers[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Imminent Roadmap (not exhaustive):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Prevent interaction through walls and obstacles,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix camera messy behavior when in spectator mode and object blurriness when moving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update marks a turning point, in the sense that we're going to return to adding content to the game and, above all, creating the whole progression system. This means that, depending on the bugs we receive, we'll be slowing down the update of this demo. [/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to try out the rest of the game![/p][p]See you soon![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest End, Patch Note & Roadmap !
notes.notes: [h2]Hello Deathliverers![/h2][p][/p][p]We've come to the end of Steam Next Fest, and what an explosive week it's been!  [/p][p][/p][h3]Thanks so much for your feedback on the [b]Pizza Deathlivery demo[/b]! [/h3][p][/p][p]Your help has been [b]invaluable[/b], especially on a game of this scale. We really want to make it as fun and engaging as possible! [/p][p][/p][p][b]This week and next[/b], we'll be continuing to update the demo regularly, to make it as clean and bug-free as possible. We'll then slow down on updates to continue developing the game, with the aim of: [/p][h3][u][b]opening playtesting sessions during the summer[/b][/u][b] (stay tuned !).[/b] [/h3][p][/p][h2]Here you can see a summary of today's patch:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/951ea255a7a26380b4307f4044c92d1d6f365696.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]And in detail :[/h2][list][*][p]Rework the city's level design (faulty road, street lighting, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Add a basketball and basket to the emergency[/p][/*][*][p]Change the polaroids text[/p][/*][*][p]Change the car spawns (more spooky!)[/p][/*][*][p]Add street and avenue names to the pizzeria map[/p][/*][*][p]Change the city hall block[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent objects to have a wrong position on start (especially the door lever)[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent player pseudo to appear/disappear when in spec mode[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]As always, don't hesitate to send us your feedback, and give us your opinion on future developments![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Patch Note Demo 1.0.5
notes.notes: [p]Hello again Deathliverers! [/p][p][/p][p]We go on optimizing the game performance while improving quality of life features.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Overview[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627462/a86272ebe3d43c56b82d0faf2909bad706d0ad45.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]In detail :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make Balloon moves slowly towards nearby players in a certain perimeter,[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent objects to go through floor (and falling forever),[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization (fog rework, now should give you at least 60 FPS on good computers - we are still trying to find pitfalls to make it better),[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Imminent Roadmap (not exhaustive)[/b]: [/p][list][*][p]Add animations to the recap of the day, to make things clearer and more juicy,,[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent interaction through walls and obstacles,,[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent dropping or throwing objects inside or behind walls and obstacles,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix camera messy behavior when in spectator mode and object blurriness when moving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Performance Update - Demo
notes.notes: [p]Hello Deathliverers![/p][p][/p][p]A quick update to improve game performance (and fix a few bugs).[/p][list][*][p][b]Working on optimization[/b] (set LOD in place + reduce enemies target checking to 2 per second instead of 1 per frame) : still work in progress, currently not as good as we expected[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix[/b]: enemies target client players correctly,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix[/b]: egg don't spawn in emergency anymore,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix[/b]: floor layered correctly in emergency,[/p][/*][/list][p]See you later![/p]
